blocks.text: Seasoned pageant girls have hopped on the Mutya ng Pilipinas train as veterans tried their luck in this year’s edition of one of the oldest national beauty contests in the Philippines. Among the 38 official candidates making up the Mutya ng Pilipinas Class of 2026 are alumnae from Binibining Pilipinas, Miss Universe Philippines and other national pageants. The pageant organization revealed the names of the successful applicants for its 58th-anniversary edition this year at the end of the final screening held at CWC Design Center in Makati City on Thursday afternoon, Oct. 1.
